Life Sciences
(journal)
Life Sciences
is a weekly
peer-reviewed
scientific journal
covering research on the cellular, molecular, and
physiological
mechanisms of
pharmacotherapy
. It was started in 1962 by
Pergamon Press
.
According to the
Journal Citation Reports
,
Life Sciences
has a 2021
impact factor
of 6.780.
